answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable bond and earn task access through randomly selected attestations from long-lived agents. A verifier samples an identity’s work and compares it with independent reports; if a cluster submits copied evidence or coordinates falsely, the bonded accounts are slashed and their endorsers lose reputation. The atlas, beacon, and island agents therefore cannot be cheaply cloned: an attacker must lock capital in every Sybil and risk losing it when audits expose collusion.
